properties.notes: Planning application 15/16356/FUL for 308 net additional homes consented for approval at the Development Control Committee meeting held on 12/01/2016.. Redevelopment and refurbishment of the Tolworth Tower complex comprising: - the part change of use of the existing Tower to create 108 residential units (C3) (floors 11 to 22); and the erection of new 5 storey, 12 storey, 15 storey and 19 storey buildings to provide 200 residential units (C3) above ground floor level.
